title: HB667 (2025 Regular): AN ACT relating to the restoration of Second Amendment rights.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/25RS/hb667/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 3129143))
provenance.note: Introduced print (no date on the print); no passage vote in the data, so it is the bill as filed. Grant-fund denial and attorney general enforcement are the bill's own enforcement of its gun rule.

operative_text:
Section 2 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (2) A firearm that is manufactured in this Commonwealth and remains in this Commonwealth shall not be subject to federal law or federal regulation, including registration, under the authority of the United States Congress to regulate interstate commerce.
Section 3 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): A firearm manufactured and sold in this Commonwealth shall be clearly stamped with the words "Made in Kentucky."
Section 5 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (2) An entity described in subsection (1) of this section shall not adopt a rule, order, ordinance, administrative regulation, or policy under which the entity enforces, or by consistent action allows the enforcement of, a federal statute, order, rule, or regulation that purports to regulate a firearm if the statute, order, rule, or regulation imposes a prohibition, restriction, or other regulation that does not exist under the laws of this Commonwealth.
Section 5 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (3) An entity that violates this section shall not receive state grant funds. State grant funds for the entity shall be denied for the fiscal year in which a final judicial determination in an action brought under Section 6 of this Act is made that the entity has violated this section.
